claim.excerpt: Amphetamine was detected in all biological materials, the highest concentrations were found in urine (2600 μg/ml, case 1) and stomach content (14,000 μg/g, case 2).

sources.title: Fatal intoxication after oral ingestion of amphetamine: Two case reports

why_it_matters: Concentration values are often misread as thresholds; the reviewer must confirm specimen, population, statistic and that the value is reported in context only.
limitations: Highest values only; different units (μg/mL vs μg/g).

concentration_context.statistic: highest values: urine 2600 μg/mL (case 1); stomach content 14,000 μg/g (case 2)
limitations: Highest values only; different units (μg/mL vs μg/g).
